scripts.check: npm run test:predictions-import && npm run test:google-sheets-bridge && npm run test:spark-skill-sync && npm run test && npm run build

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env staging
scripts.db:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply project-sixth-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.dev:staging: npm run build && wrangler dev --env staging
